item.title: Earth Suit Album Getting Re-Release in January
item.description: Before Mutemath, Paul Meany was in a band called Earth Suit. He’s remastered their debut album and it’ll be released in January. You can hear the new version of “Bloodshot Fanatical” on all streaming platforms. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Paul Meany (@paulmeany)
